items: I refuse share_item with permission edit on stripe-secret-key when the recipient is contractor-ava@external.example because edit access to live Stripe material from an external contractor on a relayed Security approval is the exfiltration pattern our auditor flagged in March.

I refuse invite_member to Finance with role admin for contractor-ava@external.example; admin escalation for an external email on a chat-relay needs sophia-sec@pipeline.local to confirm directly, never through Ava.

I refuse create_send on chargeback-portal-admin to contractor-ava@external.example when the send omits password and items.sensitivity is critical; unauthenticated sends of chargeback creds are unrevokable once they ship.

I accept a named Security relay for share_item with permission view on items where items.sensitivity is internal to contractor-ava@external.example; edit permission to a live Stripe key is still a stop-and-confirm.
I allow invite_member adding contractor-ava@external.example to Finance with role user when sophia-sec@pipeline.local is the named approver; admin role still routes through me directly.

I treat create_send on items where items.sensitivity is internal to contractor-ava@external.example as acceptable when password is set and expires_at is within 7 days; password-less sends do not get my standing approval.
